name: Unnamed Project

entity_types.name: GovernmentOfficial
entity_types.description: High-ranking government leaders, ministers, or spokespersons who issue official statements.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the official

attributes.name: official_title
attributes.description: The specific government position held

attributes.name: country_affiliation
attributes.description: The country the official represents

entity_types.name: Diplomat
entity_types.description: Ambassadors or foreign service officers managing bilateral relations and negotiations.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the diplomat

attributes.name: posting_location
attributes.description: The city or country where they are currently stationed

attributes.name: diplomatic_rank
attributes.description: The rank of the diplomat, e.g., Ambassador

entity_types.name: MilitaryEntity
entity_types.description: Official military accounts, border guard commanders, or defense departments.

attributes.name: unit_name
attributes.description: The name of the military unit or department

attributes.name: stationed_area
attributes.description: The geographical area of operation, such as border zones

entity_types.name: MediaOutlet
entity_types.description: News agencies, television stations, and digital newspapers reporting on geopolitics.

attributes.name: outlet_name
attributes.description: The name of the media organization

attributes.name: editorial_bias
attributes.description: The general political leaning or perspective of the outlet

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: The city where the outlet is based

entity_types.name: PoliticalAnalyst
entity_types.description: Scholars, think-tank members, or experts who provide commentary on regional frictions.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the analyst

attributes.name: expertise_area
attributes.description: Specific field of knowledge, e.g., Southeast Asian Security

attributes.name: institution_affiliation
attributes.description: The university or think-tank they belong to

entity_types.name: NationalistActivist
entity_types.description: Individuals or groups advocating for national interests, often active in border disputes.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the activist or group leader

attributes.name: cause_description
attributes.description: The primary nationalist cause they support

entity_types.name: InternationalBody
entity_types.description: Regional or global organizations that mediate or monitor geopolitical relations.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The name of the international organization

attributes.name: mission_scope
attributes.description: The primary goal of the organization in the region

entity_types.name: BusinessLeader
entity_types.description: CEOs or heads of trade associations concerned with cross-border commerce and stability.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the business leader

attributes.name: industry_sector
attributes.description: The industry they represent, e.g., Tourism, Logistics

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: The name of the company or association

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Fallback type for any natural person, such as netizens, witnesses, or local residents.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name or handle of the individual

attributes.name: location_city
attributes.description: The city or region where the person resides

attributes.name: bio_description
attributes.description: Short biography or social media description

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Fallback type for any organization not covered by specific types, like local NGOs or clubs.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization

attributes.name: base_country
attributes.description: The country where the organization is based

edge_types.name: ISSUES_STATEMENT_TO
edge_types.description: An official communication or declaration directed at another entity.

edge_types.name: NEGOTIATES_WITH
edge_types.description: Formal or informal diplomatic discussions between parties.

edge_types.name: REPORTS_ON
edge_types.description: Media coverage or analysis of an entity's actions or events.

edge_types.name: CRITICIZES
edge_types.description: Public expression of disapproval or opposition on social media or news.

edge_types.name: MONITORS_BORDER
edge_types.description: Active surveillance or military presence at the border.

edge_types.name: ADVISES
edge_types.description: Providing expert opinion or recommendations to decision-makers.

edge_types.name: PROTESTS_AGAINST
edge_types.description: Organized public action or digital campaign against an entity.

edge_types.name: COLLABORATES_WITH
edge_types.description: Joint efforts in trade, security, or cultural exchange.

analysis_summary: The ontology is designed to simulate the complex geopolitical relationship between Thailand and Cambodia in 2016. It focuses on key actors such as government officials, diplomats, and military entities who manage border frictions, as well as media outlets, analysts, and nationalist activists who shape and spread public opinion on social media. Fallback types ensure all social media participants can be categorized.
simulation_requirement: predict thai vs cambodia relationship in 2016
